# ReviewFlow

> ReviewFlow helps restaurants collect guest feedback and manage digital loyalty through QR code experiences.

## Public pages

- [Home](/)
- [Create a restaurant account](/signup)
- [Sign in](/login)
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](/terms)

## Product

- Guests can scan a restaurant QR code, share feedback, and access the restaurant's loyalty experience.
- Restaurant owners can manage QR requests, feedback, loyalty, and payment history.
- ReviewFlow creates editable review drafts; guests choose whether to post them.

## Notes

- Guest QR pages use the `/r/{slug}` path.
- Dashboard and account pages require authentication and are not intended for indexing.
